onboarding.tagline: All you have to do is breathe.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Guided tai chi in 5 to 20 minutes, seated or standing. Works offline.
onboarding.forRelative: I'm setting it up for a family member

practice.title: How do you want to practice?
practice.body: We pick every movement for your posture. You can change it anytime.
practice.body_relative: We pick every movement for their posture. You can change it anytime.
practice.seatedBody: On a chair. Ideal to start.
practice.standingBody: Gentle steps in one square meter.
practice.bothBody: We switch depending on the day.

feel.title: What do you want to feel?
feel.title_relative: What do they want to feel?
feel.body: Pick up to two. This sets the pace of your classes.
feel.body_relative: Pick up to two. This sets the pace of their classes.

time.title: How much time a day?
time.body: A little every day beats a lot once in a while.

hint.10: Just right to build the habit.

care.title: Any area to look after?
care.body: We adapt or skip the movements that load it.
care.safety: Manta doesn't replace your doctor. If something hurts, stop.

offline.title: Will you practice offline?
offline.body: In the park, out of town or traveling: Manta works without a connection.
offline.oftenBody: I usually practice away from home.
offline.sometimesBody: Some days I have no signal.
offline.rarelyBody: I always have Wi‑Fi or data.
offline.auto: Free classes download on their own over Wi‑Fi.
offline.manual: You can download any class whenever you like.

building.title: Building your plan
building.body: Fitting every movement to your answers.
building.body_relative: Fitting every movement to their answers.

plan.title: Your plan is ready
plan.body: Made for you. You can change it anytime.
plan.body_relative: Made for them. You can change it anytime.

account.title: Save your progress
account.body: Sign in and your plan follows you to any phone.
account.body_signin: Get your plan and progress back.
account.offline: No internet. Continue as guest: your progress is saved on this phone and goes to the cloud when you sign in.

error.network: We couldn't connect. Check your connection or continue as guest.
error.server: The server isn't responding. Try again in a moment or continue as guest.
error.rejected: We couldn't verify your account. Please try again.
error.googleExpoGo: Google works in the installed app, not in Expo Go. Sign in with Apple or continue as guest.
error.googleSetup: Signing in with Google isn't set up in this version yet.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
